paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates performance gain percentages across three models, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The horizontal axis displays the model names in the order GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical axis, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)", represents the percentage gain, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked with tick labels at intervals of 5. Two bars are presented for each model, colored purple and blue, representing "Weak Supervision" and "Strong Supervision" respectively. For GPT-4o, the "Weak Supervision" bar is approximately 2.5 units tall, while the "Strong Supervision" bar reaches approximately 26 units. The "Weak Supervision" bar for Claude-3.5-Sonnet is approximately 8.5 units, and its corresponding "Strong Supervision" bar is approximately 17 units.  Lastly, the "Weak Supervision" bar for Qwen2-72B-VL extends to approximately 9 units, with the "Strong Supervision" bar reaching roughly 14 units. The bars are not sorted in any particular order besides the listing of the models, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the distinct color coding distinguishing the supervision types.
